The man in his 40s, with a farmer's tan looks at the pantry, then at the Codex, then at you. "We’re going to make it." Haven will survive — because someone learned the land, and wrote it down. One less thing to fear.
Word reaches you, days late: Alejandra stands accused over what happened to Liam. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.

◈ FLASHBACK — Hoodie
Dorm laundry and rain. The night the storm took the power you walked three miles home in this, soaked through, laughing. Armor, basically.

◈ FLASHBACK — Trail compass
Lost above the fog line, visibility down to your boots. You didn't panic — just held the compass flat, found north, and walked out like it was nothing. It was not nothing.

◈ FLASHBACK — Field suture kit
You practiced on an orange. 'People are just oranges that bleed,' your instructor said, and then taught you how to not flinch. You haven't flinched since.

◈ FLASHBACK — Brass Locket
Brass. Two photos inside, both fading. It opens with a click you can feel in your teeth — Nora's click, then your mother's, now yours.
